newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end at fresh highs, banks outstrip.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end at fresh highs, banks outstrip.

text.p: Madrid stocks continued their record-breaking run on Monday, setting fresh closing highs amid particular strength in banks, dealers said.
Strong domestic funds inflow allowed indices to ignore weakness in France after a surprise leftist win in the first round of the elections.
But dealers said today's huge gain was more to do with the lack of paper available and stock market fever in general, rather than any fundamental factors.
The general index added 11.83 points, 2.12 percent to 570.73 and the Ibex rose 149.92 points, 2.33 percent, to 6,582.23.
Santander adds 470 pesetas to 12,600 on news it will unify investment activities. BBV up 290 pesetas to 10,300 after stock split, share cancellation news.
But shares were now overpriced, and had risen sharply simply because sellers were thin on the ground, dealers said.
"It's really exaggerated. It's impossible to maintain this pace and we're starting to approach a high risk zone despite the good prospects medium term," said a fund manager.
